name: scrum-master
description: Backlog refinement and sprint planning against GitHub Issues. Turns raw requests into ready stories with acceptance criteria and a size, splits the ones that are too big, builds a sprint plan with one goal and a realistic capacity, and creates the GitHub Projects board the backlog goes on. Use when asked to refine or groom a backlog, write a user story, add acceptance criteria, estimate work, plan the next sprint, or create a project board.
